# Function: createEmailService()

> **createEmailService**(`apiKey`): `EmailService`

Creates a Brevo-backed email service. Pass `"mock"` to record sends in
the shared in-memory mock store without calling the API.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type     |
| --------- | -------- |
| `apiKey`  | `string` |

## Returns

`EmailService`
